boundary: Manual evidence imports only. No web retrieval, scheduled research, model call or automatic development dispatch.
title: Title
sourceRules: Provide 1–20 sources with url, retrievedAt (ISO timestamp with timezone), and evidence. URL credentials, query and fragment are removed; preserve only a non-sensitive canonical citation. Review all content for sensitive data before importing.
invalid: Check required fields, source timestamps, HTTP(S) URLs, criteria and dependency UUIDs.
saveError: Save failed or its result is unknown. Retry the same request without changing its content.
unverified: Imported claims are untrusted and have not been independently fetched or verified.
redacted: Known credentials or URL parts were removed. This does not prove all sensitive data was detected.
reviewBoundary: Confirm scope and expected benefit before creating a private, quarantined backlog task. No Agent is assigned or started.
acceptanceCriteria: Acceptance criteria (one per line; up to 10)
dependencyIssueIds: Dependency task UUIDs (optional, one per line; up to 20 readable tasks)
confirmScope: I reviewed this evidence hash, scope, benefit and dependencies; create only a private backlog task without starting an Agent.
readError: Cannot read research or confirmation state. Check administrator access and retry.
created: Candidate saved; no development task or external action started.
duplicate: Existing candidate returned; no duplicate created.
